mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.10% over the past month signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.10%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points above 8.5% signals deteriorating labor market health that reduces consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances meeting the UNRATE trigger condition, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) exceeding 1.0% MoM indicate collapsing demand for goods and services, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline >1.0% MoM, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 and CPIAUCSL above 2.5% YoY signals stagflationary supply shocks that compress corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances meeting the INDPRO < 95.0 and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY condition, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 94.0 signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate earnings visibility, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO is below 94.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive Fed tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% YoY, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate above 9.0% and non-farm payrolls decline exceeding 0.5% MoM indicate severe labor market contraction that lowers consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 9.0% and PAYEMS declines >0.5% MoM, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime with GDP growth above 2.0% QoQ and housing starts exceeding 650.0, overheating demand triggers policy tightening expectations that cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 2.0% QoQ and HOUST > 650.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.
